fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Greater Miami civic affairs, including warnings about municipal bond indebtedness and a proposed convention hall, criticism of the Miami Chamber of Commerce’s finances and effectiveness, and discussion of rent increases anticipated for November 1. Coverage also addresses Miami Beach quality-of-life concerns (mosquitoes and frogs), questions about a justice of the peace’s residency, and transportation matters. Regular columns and features include humor items ("Little Geraldine"), press-box sports coverage and boxing reports tied to the Dempsey–Tunney fight, plus local notices, letters, and extensive advertising.
